notes: Corrected: the two cleft relatives *that* (t006, t012) are `added` under rules 46 and 55 rather than part of the substantival adjectives' supplied noun phrases; the substantives keep the bare *the* rule 46 gives them.
*Nor* rests on a gapped negative in the second line and is aligned to the waw actually present, headed on it (rule 35).
The cleft frame *It is* remains a single added unit headed on the copula (rule 20).
